subject: Vendor onboarding: EuroPack SpA — VAT treatment and PO/invoice routing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@europack.it>
To: mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: EuroPack SpA AP <accounts@europack.it>, marco.greco@europack.it
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 13:30:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor setup: EuroPack SpA — VAT & invoicing details

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding touchpoint earlier. To keep AP moving on our side and to make sure invoices hit the correct Redwood entity, I wanted to share our VAT / legal details and ask a couple of clarifying questions about how you need to receive invoices and whether you require an Italian fiscal representative for VAT purposes.

A few facts about EuroPack: we are incorporated in Italy (EuroPack SpA, VAT IT02467890123) and typically issue invoices under that VAT number. For some engagements with international customers we operate through a local fiscal representative when the buyer requests it.

Questions for Redwood:
- Do you require that invoices are issued to Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) or to Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V. (EU) for VAT reverse-charge purposes?
- If Redwood requires an EU-registered buyer entity to enable reverse charge, will Redwood accept a fiscal representative letter from EuroPack (we can sign one from our rep) instead of immediate VAT registration changes?

I attached: 1) EuroPack VAT declaration (pdf) and 2) a sample invoice showing our usual layout.

Attachments: EuroPack-VAT-DECLARATION-2026.pdf, sample-invoice-europack-ITA.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance
EuroPack SpA
Tel: +39 02 1234 5678

----
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@europack.it>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: EuroPack SpA — VAT & invoicing details

Hi Elena — thanks for the details and the attachments. Looping in Laura from AP and Vivek from Legal so we can confirm the exact routing and any documentation requirements.

Quick answers / follow-ups from our side:
- Redwood prefers to receive invoices addressed to Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V. for EU-facing purchases so that VAT reverse-charge can be applied where appropriate. If you issue invoices to our US entity we may need to treat them differently for tax and potentially apply withholding depending on services/supply location.
- A fiscal representative letter is fine as an interim measure provided it clearly states the representative details and is signed by an authorised rep. We will need to validate the rep against our compliance checklist.

Laura — could you confirm the vendor setup fields AP needs (invoice remit-to name and address, tax classification, PO matching rules)? Also flag whether we need a signed tax residency / non-withholding form in addition to the fiscal rep note.

Vivek — any legal concerns with accepting a fiscal rep letter vs waiting for EuroPack to reissue invoices under a different buyer entity?

If convenient, we can treat this as a standard EU non-US vendor onboarding: vendor entity = EuroPack SpA; remit-to = EuroPack bank details (from attachments); tax classification = non-US supplier (EU VAT ID provided) / reverse-charge eligible. But please confirm.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

----
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@europack.it>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Marco Greco <marco.greco@europack.it>, EuroPack SpA AP <accounts@europack.it>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: EuroPack SpA — VAT & invoicing details

Thanks Mina — appreciated.

We are happy to invoice Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V. for services that qualify for reverse charge; we have that workflow in place for other EU customers. I have attached:
- EuroPack-VAT-DECLARATION-2026.pdf (VAT registration extract)
- sample-invoice-europack-ITA.pdf (shows VAT number and absence of VAT when reverse-charge applied)
- fiscal-rep-letter-template.docx (if you prefer a fiscal rep approach we can populate and have our representative sign)

Notes:
- Our VAT ID (IT02467890123) is active and can be verified; the attached declaration is a certified extract from our commercial registry.
- If Redwood will receive the services through a Netherlands-based purchasing entity, we understand reverse-charge applies and EuroPack will issue invoices with a zero-VAT line and the appropriate legal reference.
- If Redwood insists on invoices to the US entity for contractual reasons, please confirm how AP will record VAT and whether any local withholding will be required — we may need to update our invoicing or tax treatment.

Happy to complete the fiscal rep letter if Redwood's compliance team prefers that as a supplementary file while your AP finishes the vendor record.

Best regards,
Elena

Attachments: EuroPack-VAT-DECLARATION-2026.pdf, sample-invoice-europack-ITA.pdf, fiscal-rep-letter-template.docx

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@europack.it>, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: EuroPack SpA — VAT & invoicing details

Hi Elena — thanks for the fast follow-up and the attachments, they look good. AP has reviewed the VAT extract and sample invoice. We can proceed with vendor setup under the following conditions: 

1) Remit-to / vendor name in PO: "EuroPack SpA" (legal name) with the bank details in the attached PDF.
2) Tax classification (internal): Non-US supplier — EU VAT ID provided (IT02467890123). Tax treatment: reverse-charge where applicable when invoices are addressed to Redwood Inference Netherlands B.V.
3) Invoicing: please include our PO number on the invoice and reference the Netherlands buyer entity when reverse-charge is applied. Invoices should show the VAT line as "0.00 — Reverse charge — Art. 196" or similar local reference.
4) Interim option: we can accept a signed fiscal representative letter as supplemental documentation while vendor setup completes, but AP needs the representative's registration number and contact details in the letter.

One additional ask: for Redwood's records please also provide a signed statement of tax residency (a brief note on company letterhead) so our Tax team can archive proof of non-US status for this supplier. A simple one-paragraph declaration signed by an authorised officer is sufficient.

Once those items are uploaded to the vendor portal we will issue a vendor code and enable PO creation. I created the vendor request ticket here: https://app.redwood.com/vendor/setup/VND-2026-1143 (internal link).

If everything looks good on your side, send the fiscal rep letter (if used) plus the signed residency note and we will finish setup.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0144

----
